estimator: TransactionCostEstimator: component-separated expected cost (spread crossing + market impact via Kyle's lambda or sqrt participation + fees); deterministic conservative fallback when microstructure unavailable; basis labeled.
analysis: analyze_execution: realized implementation shortfall vs decision price, side-aware realized slippage vs arrival, adverse price movement, ack/fill latencies, unfilled quantity — from genuine ManagedOrder fills + timestamps; no fabricated counterfactual fills.
separation: Expected vs realized kept strictly separate; no double-counting (execution-time model distinct from the optimizer's pre-trade ranking bps).
verdict: Expected costs explicitly qualified; realized TCA operational + side-aware.
